summary: Playa Samara/Carrillo Airport (PLD/MRCR) is a small domestic airfield on Costa Rica's Nicoya Peninsula in Guanacaste Province, serving the popular beach destinations of Playa Samara and Playa Carrillo. The airport provides a convenient alternative to the longer overland journey from Liberia International Airport, significantly cutting travel time for visitors heading to the Pacific coast beaches. It primarily handles short domestic flights operated by regional carriers connecting to San José.
faqs:
Q: Which airlines fly into Playa Samara/Carrillo Airport?
A: Regional domestic carriers such as SANSA and possibly Nature Air historically serve this airport with short flights from San José (Juan Santamaría or Tobías Bolaños).

Q: How far is the airport from Playa Samara and Playa Carrillo?
A: The airport is located near Carrillo, with Playa Carrillo just a few minutes away and Playa Samara roughly 10-15 minutes by road.

Q: Is Playa Samara/Carrillo Airport international?
A: No, it is a small domestic airport handling only short regional flights within Costa Rica.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a small airfield, services are limited to basic terminal amenities; travelers should arrange ground transport in advance.
transport_tips: Taxis and pre-arranged shuttle services are typically available at the airport, though options are limited, so booking transport ahead is recommended. Rental cars can be arranged through local agencies for exploring the Nicoya Peninsula at your own pace. The short drive to Samara or Carrillo passes through rural roads, so driving after dark is best avoided.
local_tip: If you're flexible, try to arrive during daylight hours—the short drive from the airport to Samara or Carrillo is far more enjoyable when you can catch glimpses of the surrounding dry tropical forest and Pacific coastline.
